learnings.question: What is the primary purpose of dividing a development process into smaller, iterative cycles called Sprints in the Scrum framework?
options: To eliminate the need for testing and review phases
To reduce the number of developers needed on the team
To allow for more flexibility and quicker adjustments
To extend the overall timeline of the project
learnings.learning: Scrum is an agile approach that breaks the development process into smaller, iterative cycles called Sprints to enable greater flexibility and quicker adjustments.

learnings.question: What fundamental trade-off governs the spectrum of PCIe power management states ranging from L0 to L2?
options: Signal integrity versus transmission distance
Data transmission speed versus bus width
Energy savings versus wake-up latency
Hardware longevity versus operating temperature
learnings.learning: PCIe power management operates across a spectrum of states (from active L0 to deep sleep L2) that trade off energy savings against wake-up latency to balance power efficiency with system responsiveness.
learnings.articleTitle: Power Management States in the context of PCIe

learnings.question: What is a key precision trade-off when analyzing Arabic text that has been stripped of Tashkeel (vocalization marks)?
options: String-splitting algorithms fail to separate individual words in verses
Distinct words with different meanings and pronunciations share the exact same spelling
Prepositions and conjunctions are automatically removed from the vocabulary
Right-to-left script orientation is permanently lost during DataFrame import
learnings.learning: Analyzing Arabic text without Tashkeel (vowel markings) yields a simpler and more uniform dataset, but sacrifices precision because distinct words can share identical spellings without their vocalization marks.
learnings.articleTitle: Top 20 Words to Understand the Quran: A Data Analysis using Python

learnings.question: To effectively retain personal insights and prevent ideas from being forgotten, what core strategy should be used instead of relying solely on memory?
options: Treating the brain as a permanent filing cabinet through mental repetition
Writing thoughts down, establishing a reminder system for recall, and sharing the knowledge publicly
Storing notes in private digital archives without an automated review mechanism
Relying on passive re-reading of physical notebooks rather than active quizzing
learnings.learning: To overcome natural forgetfulness and maximize the value of insights, one should stop relying solely on memory and instead write ideas down, implement an active reminder system, and share the knowledge publicly.
learnings.articleTitle: Is Your Brain the Worst Place to Store Ideas? Why I Built a Second One

learnings.question: Which Arabic term refers to the role and responsibility of human beings serving as caretakers or stewards of the Earth?
options: Hadith
Jinn
Khalifah
Taqwa
learnings.learning: In Islamic belief, life's purpose centers on worshiping God, preparing for the Hereafter, and serving as a 'Khalifah'—a caretaker or steward of the Earth responsible for preserving faith and fostering unity.
